svg.title: JINGZHANG LIFE-LINE v1.4 | COMPLETE READING MAP
svg.desc: Visible, auditable and bilingual: evidence, handover and reversible implementation

text.tspan: JINGZHANG LIFE-LINE v1.4 | COMPLETE READING MAP
Visible, auditable and bilingual: evidence, handover and reversible implementation
CONCEPT / PROVISIONAL / NOT A STATUTORY PLAN, SURVEY OR APPROVAL
Design Basis and Source List
A four-tier evidence order separates the formal brief, provisional geometry, background cases and original design models.
Statutory controls, ownership, cost and operating commitments remain unknown.
[source:SOURCE-REGISTRY] [assumption:A-CONTROLS-001]
Three-Level Scope Framework
43.6 km² coordinated research, 11.41 km² provisional overall design and 368.4 ha announced key-area frames; every derived
result is recalculated when official polygons arrive.
[metric:site_area_sqm] [depth:three_level_scope_framework]
Coordinated Research Area: Industry and Future City Research
Eight resources, three stations, two wings and an evidence ledger form the internal loop; five regional interfaces specify
exchange, entry gates, suggested responsibility and non-commitment boundaries.
[metric:regional_interface_count] [assumption:A-REGIONAL-NONCOMMIT-001]
Overall Design Area: Urban Renewal and Regulatory-Plan-Level Urban Design
One line, three stations, six seams, two wings and multiple service points; audit precedes micro-renewal, reversible pilots,
evidence review and conditional expansion.
[data:geometry/roads.geojson#ROAD-LIFELINE-001] [depth:phasing_implementation]
Detailed Design of Key Areas
The north isolates failure testing, the middle makes public care and human takeover visible, and the south separates public
and logistics continuity; all flows and stop boundaries are named.
[depth:three_key_area_detailed_design] [metric:resilience_station_count]
AI Innovation Ecosystem, Personas, and AI+ Scenarios
Six personas, twelve scenario contracts and four industrial tests bind minimum data, human authority, stop rules, evidence
and account-free equivalence.
[metric:manual_fallback_coverage_ratio] [standard:GENERATIVE-AI-INTERIM-MEASURES]
Land Use, Building Scale, and Retain-Renovate-Demolish Strategy
Six research bands cover the provisional site; candidate envelopes pass ownership, safety, heritage, accessibility,
infrastructure/maintenance and operating-cost gates before any decision.
[metric:building_footprint_ratio] [depth:retain_renovate_demolish]
Transport, Rail, Municipal Infrastructure, and Public Services
The Life-Line is an audit spine rather than a new road. Normal, degraded and minimum-safe service states retain human,
paper, offline, e-stop and visible-exit capacity.
[metric:continuity_target_hours] [assumption:A-ACCESS-001]
Blue-Green Network, Public Space, and Urban Character
Blue-green buffers, climate courts and transverse seams support cooling, rainwater interfaces, walking and care;
hydrological performance remains unclaimed until modelled.
[source:BEIJING-SPONGE-STANDARD] [assumption:A-HYDROLOGY-001]
Renewal Projects, Implementation Policy, and Phasing
Three first-year reversible pilots each carry acceptance evidence, Go/No-Go, RACI, lifecycle cost, stop and rollback rules.
[metric:first_year_pilot_count] [metric:responsibility_seat_count]
Metrics, Area Recalculation, and Compliance Matrix
EPSG:4548 geometry drives the core metrics; 23 tasks, nine standards and 15 professional-depth items form the audit chain.
[metric:green_ratio] [depth:metrics_recalculation]
Risk, Copyright, and Compliance
Privacy, safety, cost, spatial uncertainty and maturity have explicit stops. Visible Chinese uses OFL glyph outlines with
searchable semantics and no distributed font file.
[source:NOTO-CJK-OFL] [depth:risk_missing_data]
References
Formal task sources, standards, the source registry and bounded official/international background cases retain provenance,
use and limitations.
[source:OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT] [source:AGENT-TASKBOOK]
Nothing starts until authorization, field evidence, cost, professional review and stop authority are verifiable.
